fusions.name: Feint and Flush
fusions.desc: Bursts around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 2 tiles back. Each has a 50% chance to turn against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Crooked Edge
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike deals 28 damage, ignores the target's resistances and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Tables
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each such blow has a 30% chance to turn the attacker against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lucky Break
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
